formal_role: Defines the field used for flux and circulation
systems_modeling_role: Determines what movement force pressure transport or tendency means
review_warning: Flux and circulation require meaningful vector components and units

formal_role: Measures vector-field crossing through an oriented surface
systems_modeling_role: Supports outflow inflow exchange transport and boundary crossing
review_warning: Flux depends on surface choice normal direction and units

formal_role: Measures vector-field alignment around a curve
systems_modeling_role: Supports loop movement rotation eddies feedback and cyclic structure
review_warning: Circulation depends on path orientation and sampling resolution

systems_modeling_role: Determines whether crossing is interpreted as inflow or outflow
review_warning: Reversing the normal reverses flux sign

systems_modeling_role: Determines whether loop movement is positive or negative
review_warning: Reversing path direction reverses circulation sign

formal_role: Defines curve segments or surface patches in numerical approximation
systems_modeling_role: Shapes computed flux and circulation values
review_warning: Coarse sampling may miss local flow variation

formal_role: Connects the mathematical geometry to a modeled system boundary
systems_modeling_role: Supports responsible interpretation of crossing or looping
review_warning: Arbitrary boundaries may answer irrelevant questions
